what: On first open, over a background-color curtain, images inside logo pieces (1:2 pieces made by dividing the screen width into four) rest for 1s, then slide in one by one from the left at −100% (.12 stagger) over 1s power4.out, while the phrase words turn on at a .1 stagger over 1s power4.inOut. After holding .5s, the pieces exit to the right at 100% over 1s power4.in (.12 stagger) and the words turn off. .4s later the whole curtain sweeps away to the right over 1.5s expo.inOut (clip-path inset left 100%).

options.hold: Time to stay once fully in (s), default .5
options.once: “session” clears at once on a repeat visit
options.[data-fx-part=slice]: Piece slot (multiple) — the first child inside slides in
options.[data-fx-part=message]: (If any) text that lights up word by word

from.where: shared.js intro() .co-intro — original initial-transition (delay 1 · pieces xPercent −100→0 stagger .12 1s power4.out · words autoAlpha .1 1s power4.inOut · >+=.5 slice →100 power4.in · <+=.4 clipPath inset(0 0 0 100%) 1.5s expo.inOut)

note: The curtain covers the screen with position fixed (the part decides). When it ends, data-intro-done is added to the element and an fx-done event fires. Since it makes people wait, on screens opened often like an app, shorten dur · hold · wipe or use once: session.
